en: A black‑and‑white vintage panoramic view over a rural settlement by a river or lake, surrounded by low hills or mountains. Wooden houses and farm buildings with pitched roofs occupy the foreground, with more scattered buildings and fields stretching into the distance. The word "Tønset" is printed near the top left of the image, and a reference number "MINØ.43826" appears in the top right.
